turns.text: Adding M3 standoffs at the corners of the board. I am placing them one at a time so each one lands where you can see it, starting with the front left corner, six millimetres in from each edge, and five millimetres tall so a screw has something to bite into.

Now the back right corner, the same height and the same distance in from the edges, so the board sits level on both of them when you print it. I will stop at two for this test piece rather than all four, and tell you why when I am done.
Placed two M3 standoffs, at the front left and back right corners. Two diagonal standoffs are enough to test the fit; ask for the other two when you are happy with these.
